description: Level 3 Phase 5: integration, regression and quality gate. Branch level3 on top of 3790e71 (Phase 4). Dev server (vite :5174) and a clean-install production build (npm ci + npm run build in a fresh copy, served by python http.server at the root :5187 and from a sub-folder :5188/dist/). Claude desktop app built-in Chromium. No physical phone.
classification: PASS = executed and passed; FAIL = executed and failed; NOT RUN = not executed; UNVERIFIED = evidence insufficient
